tickets.name: Skyhook
tickets.note: Four games, four first baskets, and Wembanyama is driving the bus! Wembanyama goes up for the jump, and when he controls the tip, the Spurs strike first! The Bucks run their first set through Kuzma, and he lets it fly! Reid gets the ball early for the Hornets, and he does not hesitate! Okongwu owns the center circle for the Hawks, and he's been winning that tip all year long! Buckle up, buddy, this one's got some juice!

tickets.name: Lob City
tickets.note: Wembanyama leads this one, with Kuzma, Watson and Thompson riding shotgun! It all starts in the circle, and Wembanyama is standing right in it! Kuzma gets the ball early for the Bucks, and he does not hesitate! Watson is the wild card, and wild cards win pots! Thompson is the sneaky one in the bunch, and sneaky is our favorite flavor! If this one lands, they'll hear it all the way up I-85!

tickets.name: Transition
tickets.note: It's Embiid, Reid, Okongwu and Watson, four tips and four chances to light it up! It all starts in the circle, and Embiid is standing right in it! Opening minute, ball in Reid's hands, and he is HUNGRY! Big fella Okongwu in the middle, and that opening tip is his house! Here comes Watson for the Cavaliers, flying under the radar! Hold onto your hats, folks!
